# m.options.admin_messages

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

OPRA's administrative messages, including FLEX trade notices, streamed in real time.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.options.admin_messages(*, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `blink()`, `append_only()`, `ring(capacity)`
- Read from: WebSocket

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). None, the default, takes each cause from the session's `MassiveConfig.on_error`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Admin & FLEX Options (WebSocket) |
| --- | --- |
| Options Basic | Not included |
| Options Starter | Not included |
| Options Developer | Not included |
| Options Advanced | Real-time |
| Options Business | Not included |
| Real-time FLEX Trades Business | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Date` | String | The trading day of the row, as ISO yyyy-MM-dd text: the New York date of `Timestamp`. |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The row's event time. From WebSocket `t`: "The SIP timestamp in Unix nanoseconds." |
| `MessageId` | String | The unique identifier for this admin message, composed of the SIP timestamp and the sequence number (e.g., "1793911442930568079-4043826282"). |
| `Exchange` | long | The exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. |
| `Message` | String | The administrative message text as distributed by OPRA. |
| `SequenceNumber` | long | The sequence number represents the sequence in which admin events happened. These are increasing and unique, but will not always be sequential (e.g., 1, 2, 6, 9, 10, 11). |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. |
